description: A bright, over-lit triage room: a padded table under a swing-arm lamp, a glass case of supplies behind a counter, and a mop bucket standing ready by a floor drain. Posters diagram wounds with a cheerfulness the subject doesn't warrant. It's clean the way a place gets clean when it has to be: scrubbed hard, and often, and recently.

window.description: A window behind a welded grille, which lets in the light in strips and the view in pieces. Better than nothing, which was the brief.
window.name: the barred window
